title: macos-latest Test step wedges to the 20-minute job timeout on main pushes (evidence for a pending decision)
description: EVIDENCE ONLY; carrier for a decision opum-doc is taking. No ci.yml change and no fix until it returns. Job "lint . typecheck . test (macos-latest)", step "Test". Every wedge is a cancel at the job timeout-minutes: 20 (~20m20s), never a test failure. LEADER-MEASURED 2026-10-23 ~00:55Z: across 43 macOS job attempts on the last 40 main-push CI runs, 13 timeout wedges, 2 failures, 28 successes; since 2026-10-06, 9 wedges in 20 attempts; earliest wedge in that window is run 36492715205 (2026-09-28T22:29Z), so it predates LCLI-753. Recent wedges: 39873358281 attempts 1 and 2 (96f362cf; job 120152888119 then 120160392681), 39857558436 (6ff69788), 39433868424 (3aa5f020), 39360965506 (85d583c8), 37849280452, 37673274449, 37509680700, 37503495906, 36543946885, 36506568128, 36501610178, 36492715205. Same-SHA contrast: run 39857554409 at 6ff69788, started 2 s from the wedged 39857558436, passed macOS in ~8 min. SIGNATURE (leader): last (pass) line 2-18 s after the step starts, then ~19.5 min of silence until "The operation was canceled."; the last test differs each time (a runCheck case in three wedges, jobs 120152888119, 120099617794, 118665643969; a release.yml LCLI-621 case in 39873358281 attempt 2); --timeout=10000 never fires, so the bun process itself goes silent; cleanup reports "Terminate orphan process: pid (3654) (bun)". CONFIG: macos-latest falls through to ci.yml else branch `bun test --isolate --timeout=10000` with no outer timeout and no hung-only retry; ubuntu-latest bounds the same class of wedge with `timeout --kill-after=10s 6m` plus the LCLI-659 classifier retry. COVERAGE: macOS does not run on PRs (ci.yml matrix), so it is seen only after promotion. NOT COVERED by LCLI-753 (#654 bounded only the browser job install step) or LCLI-759 (browser job apt stall, a different job). RE-CHECKED BY lore-cli 2026-10-23: 39857558436 cancelled 21:28:40-21:49:01Z; 39857554409 success 21:28:38-21:36:28Z; 36492715205 cancelled 2026-09-28T22:29:49-22:50:10Z; 39433868424 cancelled 2026-10-20T13:50:26-14:10:48Z; 39873358281 both attempts cancelled at 20m (annotation: job exceeded the maximum execution time of 20m0s); ci.yml matrix and else-branch read on dev bf332124. The counts and the other run ids are the leader measurement, not re-measured here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DEC-236 clause 1a: the macos-latest Test step is bounded by an outer guard that ends a silent run well under the 20-minute job timeout (mechanism: scripts/run-hang-guarded.mjs, silence 120 s over a 14.9 s healthy maximum, wall backstop 660 s over a 579 s healthy maximum).

DEC-236 clause 1b: a HUNG run (guard exit 124) or a run whose every failing test hung at the per-test budget (scripts/ci-flake-classify.sh, LCLI-659) is retried exactly once; the green after it is labelled RETRY-GREEN as a ::warning:: annotation.
DEC-236 clause 1c: a real test failure fails the job with no retry, and a run that is still printing past the wall backstop (exit 125) is not retried either.

DEC-236 clause 2: on a hang the guard prints a process table and a macOS `sample` of every bun in the process group into the job log BEFORE killing it; positive control: the log shows a bun call graph, not an empty or no-such-process result.

DEC-236 proof, both ways, on macos-latest itself (workflow_dispatch of ci.yml on a scratch ref, stubs as real bun test files): a hanging stub is killed, sampled and retried once and the job is green with RETRY-GREEN; a second hang fails the job; a failing test fails with exactly one attempt; a clean pass has no retry. Run ids cited.
Accepting half: the full suite dispatched on the final PR head passes on macos-latest, with its run id and Test-step duration cited.

DEC-236 duty: every RETRY-GREEN on main is noted on LCLI-760 with its process sample, so the retry cannot hide a rising wedge rate; root-causing the bun wedge continues from those samples (bun version, --isolate, default concurrency). The bound is not the fix.

implementationNotes: DEC-236 (opum-doc, accepted, read from opum-ai/opum-doc dev .quest/planning.json; recorded on opum-ai/opum-doc#1276, merged 9e94e39f): bound the macos-latest Test step like ubuntu-latest, hung-only single retry labelled RETRY-GREEN, process sample of the silent bun on hang, real failures never retried, each RETRY-GREEN on main noted here with its sample, root-causing continues here. Release stays held under LCLI-751 A.

MEASUREMENTS 2026-10-23 behind the numbers (28 successful macOS jobs on the last 40 main-push CI runs, logs read): Test step 283-579 s, median 428 s; pre-Test steps 11-36 s; LARGEST gap between consecutive log lines inside the Test step 14.9 s (every job 5087+ lines). So a wall-clock cap alone cannot bound the wedge: two attempts at any cap above 579 s overrun the 20-minute job. Silence is the wedge signature, hence silence 120 s (8x the healthy maximum) with a 660 s wall backstop, 125 not retried. Budget: hang-then-pass ~36 + <=150 + 579 = ~765 s; hang-twice red after ~2 x 150 s; attempt 2 wall is clipped to a 1100 s job budget.
